fix: first Hanshin Namba line train to Kujō (3 stops: Sakuragawa, Dome-mae, Kujō)

claim: Chitose is where nikusui was born: beef and tofu in a deep broth, the soup Osaka drinkers swear by the morning after.
fix: Nikusui was born at the separate Chitose udon shop in Namba Sennichimae; this Chitose, in Taishi, is a neighbourhood okonomiyaki shop known for its okonomiyaki and yakisoba, so do not count on nikusui here.
source_quote: 難波グランド花月の側にある老舗うどん店「千とせ」独自のメニューです。
